scope: Experimental INT8 FFN W8A16 implementation and measurement. Overall FP16/INT8 hardware-limit goal remains active.
hardware_software: Ryzen AI 7 H 350 / XDNA2 AIE2P / 8 columns / performance power mode / XRT 2.25.00 / firmware 1.0.0.63 / Linux 7.0.0-38-generic / project-locked MLIR-AIE and Peano

precision.baseline: BF16 matrix weights/inputs; FP32 accumulation and recurrent state; some normalization statistics double
precision.candidate: Only FFN key/value weights INT8; on-core conversion to BF16 and BF16 MAC; scale after FP32 dot product. Other matrices remain BF16. Not native W8A8 compute or IEEE FP16.

changes: C++ per-output symmetric INT8 quantization matching CUDA FP16 scale rounding, nearest-even codes and post-dot scaling
Packed 16x256 signed codes plus 16 expanded FP32 scales; on-core dequantization without full DDR dequantized weights
Explicit experimental WeightMode::Int8FFN / --weights int8-ffn; strict artifact ABI, no silent fallback
Shared offline BF16/INT8 ChannelMix graph and common device helpers
Independent stage oracle/guards, CPU quantization tests, whole-model teacher-forced accuracy tool and offline weight-error audit

decode_abba.prefill_scope: Sequential resident replay, not batched prefill
decode_abba.conditions: Same executable and artifact root; no concurrent compilation/NPU workload; RWKV_XDNA_PROFILE disabled

text_512.quality_gate: No language-quality acceptance threshold is implied by this measurement.

control_128.quality_gate: No language-quality acceptance threshold is implied by this measurement.
control_128.workload: IDs 1,2,7,9 followed by baseline greedy tokens

whole_model_accuracy.warning: Original mixed English/Chinese smoke sample; no representative corpus or long-context production quality acceptance claimed.

error_attribution.first_token_first_divergence: Layer 0 FFN key, node 34, relative L2 0.0071559071; preceding normalization/mixing and attention/recurrent path unchanged
error_attribution.propagation: Squared ReLU and value projection propagate FFN weight error; later attention/recurrent computations receive perturbed inputs despite unchanged FP32 state arithmetic
error_attribution.note: Scale and code errors are not orthogonal/additive; scale-effect metric includes code changes.

validation.bf16: 128-token exact regression: 1116 vectors including all 960 first-token nodes and state/logits checkpoints; zero differences
validation.int8: Independent FP64 stage oracle at existing tolerances, three inputs, zero rows, immutable input/weight and BO guards passed; full-model reset/branch exact checks passed
validation.fresh_default_artifacts: Full release-int8-ffn-kernels preset succeeded, then both-mode stage tests, BF16 128-token exact regression and INT8 CLI generation passed

profile_scope: Host-observed stage wall time including DMA, scheduling and PDI, not device compute cycles.

references.FastFlowLM_access: Public npu_sequence/Gemm/dequant and Q4NX headers inspected. Core implementation distributed in binary libraries; no readable INT8 device implementation found in checkout.
references.quantization: quant/modeling/rwkv_quantize.cpp and quant/gemmv/rwkv_w8a16.cu; preserved existing checkpoint helper FP16 half-tie-up scale conversion, min 2^-24, nearest-even integer codes

limitations_and_next_work: Current baseline and W8A16 activation precision are BF16, not requested IEEE FP16; precision clarification remains unanswered
Production INT8 requires representative held-out corpus and long-context accuracy gates; FFN-only smoke measurements are insufficient
Profile prepare/recurrent/finish device cycles: recurrence is now largest measured INT8 stage and shared with BF16
Investigate measured value-residual submission overhead and fusion
Quantize other matrix-heavy operations where accuracy allows; evaluate native INT8 compute independently
Implement batched prefill and quantify real DDR/DMA bandwidth, submission overhead and full-array utilization
No architectural roofline or negligible-further-improvement claim; four benchmark processes do not establish confidence intervals
